Name: get_pm_owner_details
Description: Gets the PM Owner of the Product. Here PM means Product Manager.

Filters.Name: Product Id
Filters.Description: Filter by Product ID. This is automatically applied based on the entity context.

Filters.Name: Subscription Id
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific Subscription Id. Use when user mentions Subscription Id.

Filters.Name: Subscription Name
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific Subscription Name. Use when user mentions Subscription Name.

Filters.Name: Subscription Status
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific Subscription Status. Use when user mentions Active Subscription or Disabled Subscription.

Filters.Name: Enrollment Number
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific Enrollment Number.

Filters.Name: TPID
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific TPID.

Filters.Name: Customer Name
Filters.Description: Apply this filter when the user wants to narrow results to a specific Customer Name.

Parameters.Name: entityId
Parameters.Description: The Product entity ID (e.g., ch:product::id:GUID). ALWAYS get the value of product ID from get_product_id_from_product_name before proceeding

Parameters.Name: startDate
Parameters.Description: Start date in ISO 8601 format

Parameters.Name: endDate
Parameters.Description: End date in ISO 8601 format

Parameters.Name: view
Parameters.Description: Type of metric view - List for PM owner details

Parameters.Name: unit
Parameters.Description: Time unit for aggregation

Parameters.Name: dateOffsetInDays
Parameters.Description: Number of days offset for date range calculation. Always 0 for this function.
